subject: RFP: evidence runbook + export SOP for event retention and audit artifacts
messages:
From: Liam O'Rourke <liam@acme-secure.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acme-secure.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RFP question — evidence to demonstrate exportability and retention windows

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — Acme's security team has a follow-up set of questions for the RFP. They want a runnable evidence package we can hand to auditors that demonstrates: 1) how event/audit logs are retained and searchable over time, 2) the end-to-end export process (including manifests and integrity checks), and 3) deletion/retention-proofing for regulatory hold scenarios.

Specific asks:
- Data schema examples and minimum fields required for audit reconstruction.
- A step-by-step export SOP we could run to extract a 30-day window for a tenant (including timings for a ~200GB export).
- How long different categories of artifacts are retained by default and options for longer retention (SLA/cost).
- Evidence of chain-of-custody: signed manifests, checksums, and logging of who requested exports.
- Any limits on export format (CSV/JSON/Parquet) and API quotas.

Can you provide a sample evidence runbook and any runnable artifacts or manifests? Procurement would also like an estimate of the engineering effort Redwood requires to produce a full export for an initial POC.

Cheers,
Liam
Security Engineering — Acme Secure Manufacturing
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Liam O'Rourke <liam@acme-secure.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RFP question — evidence to demonstrate exportability and retention windows

Hi Liam — thanks, this is right in our lane. I've attached a compact evidence package and an export SOP (summary below). High-level answers first, then the attachments + link to a runnable manifest example.

Quick summary:
- Data schema: Our audit events export contains timestamp, tenant_id, request_id, user_id (hashed at rest by default), action, object_type, object_id, request_payload_sha256, response_sha256, server_node, model_version, and retention_tag. We include sample Parquet and NDJSON examples in the CSV matrix.
- Export SOP: We provide a documented SOP (export_sop_v1.pdf) that covers: generating an export job via API, snapshotting the KV/embedding caches for consistent reads, streaming export to S3 (Parquet by default), producing a signed manifest (SHA256 per file) and signed job metadata (signed with customer-specific KMS key if requested). For a 200GB tenant window, a typical run on Dedicated capacity completes in ~45–75 minutes depending on concurrency and destination throughput; included numbers are conservative.
- Retention windows: Default event retention in Hosted is 90 days for raw event blobs, 2 years for indexed audit metadata (searchable), and up to 7 years for compliance archive via cold storage at extra cost. Dedicated/Private customers can configure these via policy; we provide templates.
- Chain-of-custody: Exports produce a manifest with file-level checksums, exporter identity (service-account), export_job_id, start/finish timestamps, and an audit log entry that records the export API call, IP, and user/service account. All audit entries are immutable and retained according to the retention_policy.
- Formats & quotas: Exports support Parquet, NDJSON, and compressed CSV. API quotas are configurable; default rate allows one concurrent export per tenant on Hosted but can be raised for Dedicated with a queue size and throughput SLA.

Attachments: redwood_evidence_matrix_v1.csv (mapping fields to evidence type), export_sop_v1.pdf (step-by-step runbook), s3-manifest-example.json (signed manifest sample). Also shared: https://drive.google.com/redwood/acme-evidence-runbook-v1 for a live view and a small sample export.

Estimate for POC export: we can deliver a verified 30-day export and chain-of-custody package for a single tenant in ~5 engineer-days if we run on Dedicated; on Hosted we can provide a runnable package and guidance in ~2 engineer-days (subject to queue). Let me know your preferred destination (S3 bucket in your account, Azure Blob, or secure FTP).

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Hi Liam — attaching the finalized evidence package per our discussion and legal input. Highlights in the attached export_sop_v1.pdf:
- Step-by-step: create export job -> snapshot consistency check -> stream export to your S3 -> verify checksums using manifest -> sign manifest with customer KMS (optional) -> produce signed job metadata -> ingest into your SIEM.
- Example commands (curl + python snippets) included for reproducibility.
- Timing guidance: 200GB = ~50 minutes with 4x parallel workers to an S3 endpoint with 350 MB/s put throughput; we included a small sizing table if you need larger windows.
- POC offer: Redwood Engineers will perform the export and deliver the signed manifest + verification script. Cost estimate: 2 engineer-days on Hosted granted as a one-time POC (subject to queue) or 5 engineer-days on Dedicated with SLA priority.

Attachments: redwood_evidence_matrix_v1.csv, export_sop_v1.pdf, s3-manifest-example.json. Live sample and runnable artifacts are at: https://drive.google.com/redwood/acme-evidence-runbook-v1

If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough of the runbook and a dry-run on a non-prod tenant.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
